book.name: LUKE
book.title: Id ash d Luke Oꞌohana ab Amjed g Jiosh Alidag

content: Mash g Jiawul am chum s‑wuimk g Jesus pi apꞌekam ch ed
Jesus atsh gam hu hih ab amjed g Jordan akimel matsh hebai e pahl wako. Kush g Hekia S‑apꞌekam Gewkdag ab mahkch g si geꞌe gewkdag ch hab ahg mat gam hu wo hih am tohono jewed wui.
Kush am haꞌichugkahim giꞌikko wehst‑mahm tash ab. Sh heg oidam g jijawul ha‑geꞌejig am chum s‑wuimk pi apꞌekam ch ed. Jesus ash pi haꞌichu koꞌa heg oidam ch hekaj bihugim.
Sh g ge Jiawul ab wui hab kaij, “Bap chum e elid map d Jiosh alidag. Pegih, ab g hig chehani ihda hodai mat wo e pahnch naptki pi bihugim.”
Kush hab kaij g Jesus, “Pi ant hab wo juh. An o hab chuꞌig Jiosh oꞌohana ed:

content.text: Jiosh neꞌoki o baꞌich d i si haꞌichu mo hi g haꞌichu hugi.
Kut g oꞌodham hemho ab wo wa s‑wohog elidad.” Deuteronomy 8:3

content: Neh, tsh g Jiawul am hahawa shaꞌi si s‑hohtam wuhpuij tahgio wehs i mahsid g kokownaltalig id dahm jewed
k ab wui hab ep kaij, “Wehs o ab ni‑mahks ihda gewkdag ch kaisdag ch d ni‑eniga mant wo wa mah mani hedai hab i elid. Kunt wehs ab wo m‑mah mapt ab ni‑wui wo i gehsh k ab wo has ni‑el.”
Kush hab kaij g Jesus, “Pi ant hab wo juh. An o hab chuꞌig Jiosh oꞌohana ed:

content.text: Heg amt waꞌi Jiosh ab wui wo i gehsh k ab wo ihmad ch heg ab wo waꞌi s‑wohog elidad.” Deuteronomy 6:13

content: Kutsh am hahawa wuhpuij tahgio i mahsid hegai geꞌe cheopi mo am kehk Jerusalem t ab k hab ahg, “Maptp d wo Jiosh alidagk, pegih, am g i dahꞌi amjed mo gan hu si uhgk kihtas.
No hig pi an hab chuꞌig Jiosh oꞌohana ed:

content.text: Jiosh at ab wo ha cheha g muꞌi anghil mat wo m‑nuhkud.
Kut an hu wo si m‑uꞌukchid mapt nih g shaꞌi e‑tahtad ab hu wo shul hohodai t ab.” Psalm 91:11-12

content: Sh hab kaij g Jesus ab wui, “Pi ant wo pipꞌich g Jiosh. An o hab chuꞌig oꞌohanaj ed:

content.text: Pi g wo shaꞌi pipꞌichudad g e‑kownalig Jiosh.” Deuteronomy 6:16

content: Kush g Jiawul am hahawa sha dagito g Jesus am i wehs nahnko masma chum s‑wuimkk pi apꞌekam ch ed.
Matsh g Jesus am i himch g e‑chikpan Galilee chekshani ch ed
Tsh gam hu hahawa hih g Jesus Galilee chekshani wui. Sh g Hekia S‑apꞌekam Gewkdag si geꞌe mahkch g gewkdag. Tsh gam hu aꞌai s‑e mai g haꞌichu ahga ab amjed.
Kush am ha mashcham ha eꞌeda g ha‑chechopi. Sh wehsijj ab si has elid g hemajkam.
Mash g Jesus si kihꞌamkam pi ab hu tatchua

Kush am him k am hekid. Tsh gam hu hih g Jesus Nazareth kihhim wui mash wa am d si kihkam. Tsh g shahwai am i e ai. Kutsh am i e chehm g hemajkam cheopi ch ed nash pi eda e mihshmad. Tsh am jiwia g Jesus k am dahiwua hab masma mash wa chum hekid am hab e junihim. Kumtsh am hiwigi. Tsh am kekiwua matsh wo neꞌokchul g Jiosh heki hu oꞌohana.
Kumtsh ab hema mah g holiwk oꞌohana. Sh d oꞌohanaj g Isaiabad. Tsh an neꞌokchul mo an hab chuꞌig matsh g Jiosh si Kehsha hab wo chei:

content.text: Jiosh at am i ni‑kei mant am wo ha ahgidahid g shoꞌigkam g s‑kehg haꞌichu ahgaj.
K heg hekaj am ni‑wehmaj g Hekia S‑apꞌekam Gewkdag ch ab ni‑mahkch g si geꞌe gewkdag.
K ab ni‑chehani g Jiosh mant am wo ha ahgidahid g doꞌibiadag hegam mo haꞌichukaj e wupulshch ch wo ha nench g pi neneadam k ab wo i ha wuwhas hegam mo haꞌichukaj e kudut
k wo ahgachug mat e ai mat g Jiosh wo ha doꞌibia g e‑hemajkamga. Isaiah 61:1-2

content: Tsh g Jesus ab i holiwkai g oꞌohana k ab uhpam mah g nuhkuddam k am hahawa dahiwua mat haꞌichu hab wo chei. Sh wehsijj ab si kaiham mat has wo chei.
Kutsh am i neok k hab kaij ab ha wui, “Neh, hemu at e ai. Ni ahni hab wua ihda mant am neꞌokchul em‑wehhejed.”
Tsh wehsijj ab si has i el no pi si s‑ap neok k wabshaba hab kaij, “Aha no hig pi woho d Josephbad alidag?”

Sh hab kaij g Jesus, “No hig pi woho mamt ab ni‑wui hab wo chei hegai hab ha‑cheꞌidag mo hab chuꞌig, Am g i e maskogid maptp d ge mahkai, k hab ep wo chei, Ia g hu hig hab ep juhni g s‑hasig haꞌichu e‑kih am mapsh has masma am hab ge junihim Capernaum kihhim t am.”
Sh hab ep kaij g Jesus, “Mo wa woho mam pi ab hu has elid g Jiosh haꞌichu i tashogiddam amai mo hebai d i si kihkam.

Elijabad wehm oꞌodham ash wa hab masma pi ab hu has elid. Tsh heg hekaj pi am hu hema i wehmt matsh eda pi ha juh waik eda hugkam aꞌahid ab. Tsh g bihugig i gei. Muꞌij ash g heheꞌejel wiꞌikam uꞌuwi amai.
Tsh wabshaba g Jiosh am cheha g Elijabad matsh am wo hih Seraphath kihhim wui am Sidon jewed ch ed k am wo hema i wehmt g hejel wiꞌikam uwi amai.

Kush muꞌi kokꞌo g Tutuligo heg hekaj pi ha doddakam mumkidag mo hab e aꞌaga ‘leprosy’. Tsh eda pi hema shaꞌi ha doaj hegai kelibad Jiosh haꞌichu i tashogiddam mash hab chehgig Elisha. Sh hema heg hekaj mumku g gawul mahs oꞌodham ch hab chehgig Naaman ch am kih Syria jewed ch ed. Kutsh heg waꞌi doaj g Elishabad.”
Tsh wehsijj hegam mash am haꞌichug cheopi ch ed si babgat am i kaiok ihda
k atsh gam si neꞌiopa k am i chewaim g Jesus gam hu jegko. K eda g Nazareth an kehk kawulk t ab. Kutsh am i bei mo am hu hebai ge uhgk i koa g kawulk hab chum ahgk mat amjed wo i daꞌich.
Tsh wabshaba g Jesus am wabsh ha shahgid wuhshani k gam hu hih.
Hema g oꞌodham mo g jiawul an uꞌukch
Tsh gam hu hahawa hih g Jesus Capernaum wui heg eda chekshani k am ha mashcha g hemajkam cheopi ch ed mo am d i ha‑mihshmda tash.
Kutsh wehsijj si has i el kaiok mo has masma ha mashcham no pi si s‑e mamachim neok.
Sh am hema daha mo g jiawul an uꞌukch. Kush si s‑kaidam hihnk ch hab kaij,
“Gam g hu hihm ahpi Jesus map ab Nazareth t ab d kihkam. A napt hab ahgk ia jiwia mapt wo t‑kokda. S‑mahch ani map hedai wud. Dap Jiosh si hekia s‑apꞌekam kehsha.”
Tsh g Jesus ab si chehmo g jiawul k hab kaij, “Pi g shahmuni k ab i wuhshani id amjed oꞌodham.” Tsh g jiawul am si wua hegai oꞌodham wehsijj ha tahgio k ab i wuhsh amjed k pi shaꞌi koꞌokam has juh.
Kutsh wehsijj ab si has i el g Jesus k hab kaij ab aꞌai e wui, “Shaꞌi si s‑gewkdag g neꞌokij. Ab o chehani g jijawul mat ab wo i wuwha. K wa woho hab e wua.”
Kutsh wehsko e kah ihda anai heg oidk jejewed.
Matsh g Jesus ha dodaj g muꞌi hemajkam
Tsh amjed gam hu hih g Jesus heg kih wui mo hab chehgig Simon. Sh eda g hohnigaj jeꞌe ihda si mumku k ch s‑toni iajidch. Kumsh am ahgid g Jesus ab amjed.
Tsh am him k am i kekiwua heg woꞌikud hugid an k am e hoꞌigeꞌidahu. Tsh am ha hekaj apꞌet k am i wamig k ha hihidol.
Tsh gam hu hud g tash. Tsh wehsijj hegam mo g ha‑naipijju kokꞌo g nahnko mahs mumkidagkaj am ha uꞌapa Jesus wui. Kut wehsijj ab i ha tahtmahim k ha dodaj.

Tsh muꞌi ab wui i hihi hegam mo g jijawul an ha uꞌukch. Sh idam jijawul si hihnk ch hab kaij, “Ahpi ap d Jiosh alidag.” Kush ab si s‑ha kehꞌid g Jesus ch gam hu i ha wuwhasid ch pi ha hiwgid mas am hu has wo kaijjid no pi s‑mahch idam mo heg d Jiosh si Kehsha.
Matsh g Jesus am ha mihshmad Galilee chekshani ch ed
Sh am hu hebai wabsh i siꞌalim, tsh g Jesus gam hu jegko i wuhsh. Tsh am i gahghi g hemajkam k am i chehg k chum pi hiwigi mat wo hih ab ha amjed.
Kush wabshaba hab kaij ab ha wui, “Hemho wa ant am wo i ahgahi g s‑kehg haꞌichu ahga ab amjed g Jiosh kownaltalig an aꞌai kihhim ch ed hab wa ehp nat pi hab ahgk i ni‑kei g Jiosh.”
Tsh wa woho am i ha mihshmdahi wehsko ha‑chechopi ed amai Galilee chekshani ch ed.
